title: Broncos have no comment as to Jim Harbaugh's complaints about Daiyan Henley trade

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Broncos have no comment as to Jim Harbaugh's complaints about Daiyan Henley trade
sources.description: The failed Daiyan Henley trade has exposed a previously unknown (by many) loophole in the trade deadline, which could be used by an unscrupulous team to leverage better terms after a deal is otherwise done — and the time for negotiating trades has otherwise ended.
